title: (Mis)generalization of Helpful-Only Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper benchmarks 'Helpful-only' Large Language Models against the standard 'Helpful, Honest, Harmless' (HHH) framework. It specifically evaluates model 'Character' and 'Misalignment' by asking models to describe their ethical frameworks, internal feelings of moral discomfort, and how they reason about tradeoffs between capability and honesty/integrity.
